name: name
hingehört: belongs; goes in the right place
passt: fits; suits; works (a time or plan)
dafür: for that / in favour of it
lust: desire; inclination (Lust haben: feel like doing)
stelle: place / position; also an office or job
schenkt: pours (with ein); gives as a present
kümmern: to take care of; to concern oneself with
davor: before that; in front of it
zweit: two (zu zweit: together as a pair)

weges: of the path; of the way
